56754.summary: The class discusses the structure and purpose of the Bible, focusing on why the Old Testament is longer and covers more time than the New Testament, despite the New Testament being centered on Christ. It explores themes of God's foreknowledge, human free will, and the ultimate fulfillment of God's purpose in Christ's coming. The class also touches on the parable of the workers in the vineyard, emphasizing the grace of God and the importance of seizing opportunities for service.
